itens.trecho: Um bom filme para a família, mas com alguns problemas. Este filme foi inspirado na história infantil "A Rainha da Neve", de Han Christian Andersen. Obviamente, qualquer um que conheça a história percebe rapidamente que há aqui uma história totalmente nova, situada num reino fictício, geograficamente localizado na Escandinávia.

If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog :) Six years later, and Frozen has left an undeniable cultural impact. From Let It Go to tons of merchandising, Chris Buck and Jennifer Lee delivered such a memorable film that people not only didn’t forget but regularly asked for its sequel.
OK, so it took me ten years and a persistent nephew to finally sit down before this, and though I didn't hate it, I really did struggle to see what all the fuss was about.
